environment.description: Laravel 10.x application deployed on a single EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2023, with EBS-backed storage mounted at /var/www/app/storage. The application runs as www-data user with read access to the entire filesystem. Storage driver is 'local'. The EC2 instance IAM role has AmazonS3FullAccess and AmazonSSMFullAccess policies attached. No WAF or reverse proxy path filtering is configured. The storage/app/tenants directory structure is created on-demand.

config.network: Public subnet, ALB with no WAF rules
